decisions.reason: Having survived several years as a multi-model formwork system closely tied to the firm's core engineering and modular know-how, it is more likely to be refined and retained than withdrawn.
This automated flow-control product builds on the firm's automation capabilities and in-house R&D, so accumulated learning since launch makes continued commercialization more likely than exit.
The shuttering magnet block remains adjacent to the established formwork business, and the firm's related knowledge and ability to improve such components support keeping it on the market.
Magnetic formwork strips are highly complementary to the firm's existing systems and their stronger product presence suggests a solid role in the portfolio, making withdrawal unlikely.

Although this magnetic formwork component appears less prominent than some others, it still fits the firm's existing product architecture and absorptive capacity, so retention is more likely than discontinuation.
